mapper.sql: tc.id, tc.code, tc.title, tc.description, tc.project_id, req.source_id as requirement_id, api.target_id as api_id, tc.source, tc.source_ref, tc.status, tc.priority, tc.tags, tc.version, tc.lifecycle_status, tc.archived_at, tc.deleted_at, tc.created_at, tc.updated_at

choose.otherwise: and tc.deleted_at is null and coalesce(tc.lifecycle_status, 'ACTIVE') = #{query.lifecycleStatus}

where.if: and ( position(lower(#{query.keyword}) in lower(coalesce(tc.code, ''))) > 0 or position(lower(#{query.keyword}) in lower(coalesce(tc.title, ''))) > 0 or position(lower(#{query.keyword}) in lower(coalesce(tc.description, ''))) > 0 or position(lower(#{query.keyword}) in lower(coalesce(tc.source_ref, ''))) > 0 or position(lower(#{query.keyword}) in lower(coalesce(tc.tags, ''))) > 0 )

mapper.select:
select from asset_test_case tc left join asset_link req on req.target_type = 'CASE' and req.target_id = tc.id and req.source_type = 'REQUIREMENT' and req.link_type = 'VERIFIES' and req.deleted_at is null left join asset_link api on api.source_type = 'API' and api.target_type = 'CASE' and api.target_id = tc.id and api.link_type = 'COVERS' and api.deleted_at is null
order by tc.created_at desc limit #{query.size} offset #{query.offset}

select count(*) from asset_test_case tc left join asset_link req on req.target_type = 'CASE' and req.target_id = tc.id and req.source_type = 'REQUIREMENT' and req.link_type = 'VERIFIES' and req.deleted_at is null left join asset_link api on api.source_type = 'API' and api.target_type = 'CASE' and api.target_id = tc.id and api.link_type = 'COVERS' and api.deleted_at is null

select from asset_test_case tc left join asset_link req on req.target_type = 'CASE' and req.target_id = tc.id and req.source_type = 'REQUIREMENT' and req.link_type = 'VERIFIES' and req.deleted_at is null left join asset_link api on api.source_type = 'API' and api.target_type = 'CASE' and api.target_id = tc.id and api.link_type = 'COVERS' and api.deleted_at is null where tc.id = #{id} and tc.deleted_at is null

select from asset_test_case tc left join asset_link req on req.target_type = 'CASE' and req.target_id = tc.id and req.source_type = 'REQUIREMENT' and req.link_type = 'VERIFIES' and req.deleted_at is null left join asset_link api on api.source_type = 'API' and api.target_type = 'CASE' and api.target_id = tc.id and api.link_type = 'COVERS' and api.deleted_at is null where tc.id = #{id}

select from asset_test_case tc left join asset_link req on req.target_type = 'CASE' and req.target_id = tc.id and req.source_type = 'REQUIREMENT' and req.link_type = 'VERIFIES' and req.deleted_at is null left join asset_link api on api.source_type = 'API' and api.target_type = 'CASE' and api.target_id = tc.id and api.link_type = 'COVERS' and api.deleted_at is null where tc.project_id = #{projectId} and lower(tc.source) = lower(#{source}) and tc.source_ref = #{sourceRef} and tc.deleted_at is null order by tc.created_at desc limit 1

select from asset_test_case tc join asset_link req on req.target_type = 'CASE' and req.target_id = tc.id and req.source_type = 'REQUIREMENT' and req.source_id = #{requirementId} and req.link_type = 'VERIFIES' and req.deleted_at is null left join asset_link api on api.source_type = 'API' and api.target_type = 'CASE' and api.target_id = tc.id and api.link_type = 'COVERS' and api.deleted_at is null where tc.project_id = #{projectId} and tc.deleted_at is null and coalesce(tc.lifecycle_status, 'ACTIVE') = 'ACTIVE' order by tc.created_at desc
mapper.update: update asset_test_case set title = #{title}, description = #{description}, source = #{source}, source_ref = #{sourceRef}, status = #{status}, priority = #{priority}, tags = #{tags}, version = #{version}, lifecycle_status = #{lifecycleStatus}, archived_at = #{archivedAt}, deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
update asset_test_case set version = #{version}, lifecycle_status = #{lifecycleStatus}, archived_at = #{archivedAt}, deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select from asset_test_step where case_id = #{caseId} order by step_order asc
